changes.after: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for working with 3D documents. It supports reading and writing OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files through a Scene/Node/Mesh object graph. The library requires no native runtime or external SDK and is compatible with Python versions 3.7 through 3.12.
changes.before: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a Python library for working with 3D documents, supporting formats such as .obj, .stl, .gltf, .glb, .dae, .3mf, and .fbx. It enables developers to create, read, convert, and save 3D scenes using primitives like Box, Sphere, and Cylinder, and manage geometry through Scene, Node, Entity, and Mesh classes. Users can define materials, control mesh topology, and export scenes to multiple 3D formats using FileFormat and save options. The library is compatible with Python versions 3.7 through 3.12 and requires Python >=3.7.
